confidence_notes: Holistic estimates of typical July 2026 prices, not checked against live menus, booking sites or listings. Restaurant, coffee and beer anchors are better grounded than seasonal hostel and hotel rates. Cocktail and wine were set relative to the beer anchor because direct knowledge is thinner. The FX value comes from a search summary of the RBA exchange-rates overview page; the page itself was not opened to confirm it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: southern European capital price levels, reasoned against comparable Mediterranean capitals rather than a single named city, with July peak accommodation demand in Athens taken into account.
